गीता

GĪTĀ . See under bhagavad gītā.

गीतप्रिया

GĪTAPRIYĀ . A follower of Skandadeva. (Śloka 7, Chapter 46, śalya Parva).

गीतविद्याधर

GĪTAVIDYĀDHARA . A great musician among the gandharvas. When he found that sage pulastya had no liking for music he teased the sage by making the sounds of a boar. The enraged sage cursed him and turned him into a boar. He got relief from the curse when ikṣvāku killed him and gītavidyādhara became his old self again. (Chapter 46, sṛṣṭi Khaṇḍa, padma purāṇa).
